name: ARAB 1002
title: Elementary Arabic II
description: Beginning Modern Standard Arabic. Emphasis on speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills. Taught in Arabic.
requirement_description: ARAB 1001 or instructor consent; not open to students with three or more years of Arabic in high school. Those with Arabic knowledge require instructor consent. Cannot be taken out of sequence after passing ARAB 1003, 1004, 1102, 1103, or 1104.
